summary:
Implementation plan to streamline the portfolio:
1. Replace below-hero schematic marquee with a pure cinematic Showreel showcase.
2. Strip verbose duration bars, scrub chrome, and beat buttons from showreels for a zero-chrome cinematic look.
3. Minimalize the Architectures section to prioritize visual impact over repetitive text.
4. Scale up the hero orbiting avatars to 110-130px desktop and 65-75px mobile.
5. Trim verbose walls of text from hero AI chat popups down to concise 1-2 sentence responses.
